# PDF Quick Tools

PDF Quick Tools is a free browser-based PDF utility platform. Files are processed locally in the browser for the client-side PDF tools.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/): Free online PDF tools.
- [All tools](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/tools): Browse PDF utilities.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/privacy): Data handling and advertising disclosure.
- [Terms of Use](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/terms): Usage terms.
- [Contact](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/contact): Contact information.

## PDF tools

- [Compress PDF](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/compress-pdf)
- [Merge PDF](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/merge-pdf)
- [Split PDF](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/split-pdf)
- [PDF to JPG](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/pdf-to-jpg)
- [JPG to PDF](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/jpg-to-pdf)
- [Watermark PDF](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/watermark-pdf)
- [Sign PDF](https://pd-f-tool.vercel.app/sign-pdf)
